findings.current: “Why do you say ‘I hear he’s come to visit’ instead of just ‘he came to visit’?”
findings.defect: Taekyung purports to quote Hyuk Mujin’s wording, but Hyuk Mujin actually said, “I hear there’s a visitor downstairs.” The mismatched quotation blurs the joke about his conspicuously indirect phrasing.
findings.rationale: Echoing the preceding line exactly makes Taekyung’s objection and the setup for Cheongpung’s secondhand message immediately clear.
findings.replacement: “Why do you say ‘I hear there’s a visitor downstairs’ instead of just ‘there’s a visitor downstairs’?”
findings.source: Chapter 527, Hyuk Mujin announcing the first visitor

findings.rationale: The replacement preserves Taekyung’s incredulous comic reaction without introducing an unglossed Korean kinship term or changing the event.
findings.source: Chapter 527, Taekyung reacting to the Kongtong Sect Leader

summary: Continuity, terminology, hooks, and state remain coherent across Chapters 525–529. Two minor dialogue-level issues disrupt the otherwise consistent contemporary English voice.
